profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at VisualVault
profile.summary: Former Educator pursuing a Masters in Computer Science with an interest in database development, web applications, and data analytics. Self motivated learner looking for new challenges and career opportunities. Analytical and innovative with interpersonal skills and attention to detail within the big picture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I serve as a primary technical resource for VisualVault's core engineering team, leading code reviews, clearing development blockers, and mentoring engineers to keep delivery moving while remaining hands-on across the full stack day to day. My work spans full-stack development on .NET Web API and Angular, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and applied AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architectural Design · Angular · ASP.NET Core · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Anthropic Claude · Leadership · Data Warehousing · C# · TypeScript

positions.title: Database Admin/Music Associate
positions.description:

• Automates daily computer tasks for Music Office staff using scripts
• Maintains Windows and Apple Computer Systems for Music Office
• Training and Working with End Users of Computer Systems

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:

• Implements social media marketing strategies through Twitter, Instagram, Soundcloud, ect.

projects.title: Georgia-Pacific Applied Statistics Data Analysis Project
projects.description:
• Lead discussions with key Georgia Pacific stakeholders to uncover critical business insights used to inform and validate project thesis as it relates to increasing customer value
• Perform data analysis to identify variables that support project thesis; data analysis includes cleaning data, running linear regressions to understand relationships, and creating predictive models
• Work with interdisciplinary team members to ensure project deliverables are on track and appropriate resources are utilized
• GP acknowledged the project as a practical solution and awarded first place prize
• Project sponsor: Christopher Pinnock
